parameters.query:
SELECT
  wi.id::text AS watch_item_uuid,
  wi.watch_id,
  wi.watch_type,
  wi.display_name,
  wi.search_term,
  wi.aliases,
  wi.match_mode,
  wi.match_field,
  wi.category,
  wi.subcategory,
  wi.parent_group,
  wi.tags,
  wi.source_filter,
  wi.alert_category_filter,
  wi.min_priority,
  wi.address,
  wi.municipality,
  wi.county,
  wi.state,
  wi.zip,
  wi.block,
  wi.lot,
  wi.qualifier,
  wi.parcel_id,
  wi.latitude,
  wi.longitude,
  wi.gis_enabled,
  wi.gis_lookup,
  wi.nearby_enabled,
  wi.radius_ft,
  COALESCE(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'subscriber_uuid', s.id::text,
        'subscriber_id', s.subscriber_id,
        'name', s.name,
        'ntfy_topic', s.ntfy_topic
      )
    ) FILTER (
      WHERE wir.active = true
        AND s.active = true
        AND s.id IS NOT NULL
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) AS recipients
FROM watch_items wi
LEFT JOIN watch_item_recipients wir
  ON wir.watch_item_id = wi.id
LEFT JOIN subscribers s
  ON s.id = wir.subscriber_id
WHERE wi.active = true
  AND (wi.starts_at IS NULL OR wi.starts_at <= NOW())
  AND (wi.expires_at IS NULL OR wi.expires_at > NOW())
GROUP BY wi.id
ORDER BY wi.watch_id;
